# Unconditional table drop on downgrade

The downgrade calls op.drop_table('embeddings') without checking existence or taking precautions, which will remove the table and its data if present and may raise errors if the table does not exist or has dependent objects.

- `alembic/versions/0003_embeddings.py` — `alembic.versions.0003_embeddings.downgrade`
